discrepancy.detail: The task premise cites an old grey-veil meansat of 12 (0.12). Re-measured on the realism head under the quad env with the repo's own catchlight-png.ts saturation: the C-texture disc meansat is 0.5224/0.5048, not 0.12. The 0.12-0.14 figure reproduces only as the eye-crop (sclera-dominated) meansat: C 0.1418/0.1487, D 0.1409/0.1478 — no brown iris moves that metric without going neon. The gate below therefore bars the disc metric: [0.30,0.60] beats any grey-veil reading (0.12-0.15) by 2x+ and stays below the control neon-red 0.64. Both C and D pass it; the upgrade is carried by fibre detail (2x texture angular contrast at r55/70) and hue (17->19.4deg deeper brown), stated honestly. E addendum: render-space hue (HSV hue of mean in-disc RGB, the same formula that reads C as 17.0/16.8) reads E as 16.7/16.5 - the rig lighting compresses texture hue, so the hue ~19deg win lives at texture level (E annulus mean-per-pixel HSV hue 19.3/19.2; bake-off identical-harness verdict 19.5). The render gate only requires the brown band [14,26], which 16.7/16.5 clears with margin; ringRG here is mean(R-G) over in-disc pixels.
